name: humid_air_1691_cycling_on_refused_session_kept
description: A nat-vent session started on dry air; the fan cycled off at the band midpoint; the outdoor air then turns wetter than the house, so the fan is not switched back on (start-only: the session itself is not ended)
notes: 11:00 dew points: indoor 71F at 57.0% = 55.0F; outdoor 65F at 90.0% = 61.99F (wetter than the house, below the 65F ceiling). Before 11:00 no humidity is known (= today's behaviour).

Three-exercise protocol (CLAUDE.md Sec 10): (a) effectiveness: deleting the cycling-on guard makes 11:30 read nat_vent_fan_on (the fan back on into humid air). (b) docs-production: docs/08-COMPUTATION-REFERENCE.md 'Humid-air guard (Issue #1691)' states this rule and production applies it through humidity_facts.humid_air_verdict. (c) occupant: the fan would pull 62F-dew-point air into a 55F-dew-point house for the rest of the evening.

verdict.summary: No fan restart into humid air; the session stays

events.note: Morning, no humidity known: nat-vent eligible by temperature.
Window opens: the session starts (no humidity known yet).
Indoor at the off threshold: the fan cycles off, the session stays.
The outdoor air turns humid (dew point 62F against the house's 55F).
Indoor at the on threshold: the fan would cycle back on.

assertions.reason: No humidity known: today's behaviour, the session starts.
The fan cycles off at the off threshold.
The fan is not cycled back on into wetter-than-house air.
Reported once, with the cycling starter.
D4 start-only: the running session is not ended by humidity.
